name: Metaview
summary: Agentic recruiting platform for sourcing, screening, interviewing and interview notes.
description: Metaview provides recruiting agents that source candidates, run outreach, review applications, take interview notes and book screening calls, sharing context across the hiring process. Its fillmore agent handles autonomous outbound recruiting. The Free plan includes 100 sourced profiles; Pro costs $100 per user per month. The company announced $60M in new funding led by Insight Partners. Its agents are designed to share context from first search to final offer.

howToUse.title: Open Metaview
howToUse.description: Open Metaview and start for free, or book a demo, to use the recruiting agents.

howToUse.title: Source candidates and run outreach
howToUse.description: Tell Metaview who you need so an agent can source candidates and run outreach. fillmore handles autonomous outbound recruiting and can book screening calls.

howToUse.title: Review through to the offer
howToUse.description: Review applications, keep interview notes, and continue sharing context across the hiring process from the first search to the final offer.

howToUse.title: Compare Free and Pro
howToUse.description: The Free plan includes 100 sourced profiles. Pro costs $100 per user per month when the team needs a higher allowance.

features_fr: Plateforme de recrutement agent pour le sourcing, la sélection, les entretiens et les notes d'entretien.

Metaview fournit des agents de recrutement qui recherchent des candidats, mènent des actions de sensibilisation, examinent les candidatures, prennent des notes d'entretien et réservent des appels de sélection, partageant le contexte tout au long du processus de recrutement.
Son agent Fillmore gère le recrutement sortant de manière autonome.
Le forfait gratuit comprend 100 profils sourcés ; Pro coûte 100 $ par utilisateur et par mois.
